module_summary: AXI-Stream to 10GBASE-R 64b/66b transmit encoder: a 7-state FSM emits start, payload, padding and parallel-LFSR CRC32 FCS as typed blocks, lane-swapped for DIC, then encoded into 66b blocks.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/PAYLOAD/PAD/FCS/ERR/IFG controller selecting output block type and tready

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: AXI-Stream payload input masked by tkeep

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input valid; starts frames and detects underflow

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready driven by FSM

anchors.name: s_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End-of-frame marker moving FSM toward pad/FCS

anchors.name: s_axis_tkeep
anchors.why: Byte enables converted to empty count

anchors.name: s_axis_tuser
anchors.why: Bit0 marks bad frame forcing ERR; PTP tag source

anchors.name: encoded_tx_data
anchors.why: 64-bit encoded block payload output

anchors.name: encoded_tx_hdr
anchors.why: 2-bit sync header output (data or control)

anchors.name: output_type_reg
anchors.why: Block type selecting encoded block format and sync header

anchors.name: output_type_next
anchors.why: FSM-chosen block type: idle, start, data, term_n or error

anchors.name: output_data_reg
anchors.why: Lane-aligned block data before encoding

anchors.name: s_tdata_reg
anchors.why: One-beat payload register feeding CRC LFSRs and output

anchors.name: s_empty_reg
anchors.why: Empty bytes in last word; selects FCS layout, term type and IFG offset

anchors.name: crc_state_reg
anchors.why: CRC32 states; entry 7 running CRC, others per-tail-width

anchors.name: reset_crc
anchors.why: Reinitialises running CRC

anchors.name: update_crc
anchors.why: Advances running CRC during payload/pad

anchors.name: fcs_output_data_0
anchors.why: Final block merging tail bytes with inverted CRC

anchors.name: fcs_output_data_1
anchors.why: Spill-over FCS block for second cycle

anchors.name: frame_min_count_reg
anchors.why: Bytes remaining to minimum frame length; drives PAD

anchors.name: ifg_count_reg
anchors.why: Inter-frame gap countdown in IFG state

anchors.name: deficit_idle_count_reg
anchors.why: Deficit idle count for DIC across frames

anchors.name: swap_lanes_reg
anchors.why: Shifts output by four lanes, remapping start/term block types

anchors.name: swap_data
anchors.why: Upper half held for lane-swapped output

anchors.name: delay_type_valid
anchors.why: Deferred terminate type pending when swapped

anchors.name: delay_type
anchors.why: Block type deferred one cycle for swapped lanes

anchors.name: frame_reg
anchors.why: Inside-frame flag dropping rest of frame and holding IFG

anchors.name: frame_error_reg
anchors.why: Frame error latched; routes PAD to ERR

anchors.name: frame_start_reg
anchors.why: Start pulse triggering timestamp capture and start_packet

anchors.name: cfg_ifg
anchors.why: Configured inter-frame gap

anchors.name: cfg_tx_enable
anchors.why: Transmit enable gating frame start

anchors.name: error_underflow
anchors.why: Pulse when tvalid drops mid-frame

anchors.name: start_packet
anchors.why: Start-of-packet with lane position

anchors.name: m_axis_ptp_ts
anchors.why: Transmit timestamp output

anchors.name: m_axis_ptp_ts_valid
anchors.why: Valid pulse for timestamp and tag

anchors.name: m_axis_ptp_ts_reg
anchors.why: Timestamp latched at frame start with lane-swap correction

groups.name: TX FSM
groups.description: Sequences start, payload, padding, FCS, error and IFG blocks

groups.name: Input datapath
groups.description: Masks bytes and registers payload with empty count

groups.name: CRC generator
groups.description: Eight LFSRs compute CRC per tail width and build FCS blocks

groups.name: Frame and IFG counters
groups.description: Minimum frame padding and IFG with deficit idle count

groups.name: Lane swap and block encoder
groups.description: Realigns lanes and encodes typed blocks into 64b/66b format

groups.name: PTP and status
groups.description: Start-of-frame timestamping, tag output and status pulses
